map.根据体重与活动/气候估算每日饮水量。: Estimate daily fluid needs from body weight, activity duration and climate, and break the total between plain water, beverages and the water held in food.
map.📖 查看「每日饮水推荐 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Daily Water Intake Recommendation User Guide"
map.饮水 ≈ 体重(kg) × 35 mL × 活动 × 气候系数: Water ≈ weight (kg) × 35 mL × activity × climate factor
map.含食物水分，炎热/运动需增加。: Includes water from food; more is needed in hot weather or with exercise.
map.📚 深度解析：每日饮水推荐: 📚 Deep Dive: Daily Water Intake Recommendation
map.hydration 管理：由体重估每日饮水: Hydration management: estimate daily water intake from body weight
map.运动/炎热：增量补偿出汗: Exercise / heat: increase to compensate for sweating
map.科普纠偏：饮水并非越多越好: Correcting a myth: more water is not always better
map.算法：推荐饮水量 = 体重(kg) × 35 × 活动系数 × 气候系数(mL): Algorithm: recommended water = weight (kg) × 35 × activity factor × climate factor (mL); cups = recommended ÷ 250. Activity/climate factors are ≥1 (e.g. 1.2, 1.1). About 20-30% comes from food water. All values must be >0.
map.例1（65kg、活动 1.2、气候 1）：推荐 65×35×1.2×1=2730: Example 1 (65 kg, activity 1.2, climate 1): recommended 65×35×1.2×1 = 2730 mL, about 10.9 cups (250 mL). Example 2 (70 kg, activity 1.35, climate 1.1): recommended 70×35×1.35×1.1 = 3641 mL.
map.是粗略说法；更准确按体重×30–35mL 估，运动/炎热/哺乳需加。但总量含食物: It is a rough rule; more accurately, estimate by weight × 30-35 mL, adding more for exercise, heat or breastfeeding. But the total includes water from food, so you need not drink it all.
map.喝水过量有害吗？: Is drinking too much water harmful?
map.有水中毒（低钠）风险，尤其短时间大量；肾功能正常者一般不易，但马拉松等长时间运动: There is a risk of water intoxication (low sodium), especially with a large amount in a short time; people with normal kidney function are generally not at risk, but long-duration exercise such as a marathon requires some salt replacement.
